title: Kamishiro Rui — Talking At Dusk〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I came to ask Tsukasa if he wanted to eat lunch together, but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It seems he's hard at work ahead of our session after school.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I...might be held back a year!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There are going to be supplementary classes all through next week, and there's a test on the last day that will determine whether I'm held back or not.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've swallowed my pride to ask something of you. Please, help me study!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I'm not surprised that Tsukasa's already started studying by lunch break.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd hate to distract him, so I suppose I'll go to the school store alone.
Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, hello Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Excuse me for approaching you out of the blue. Do you have a moment?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I do indeed. How can I help you?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There's something I'd like to ask you about.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ask me? Hm... Would you care to share?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Certainly. Akito and Shiraishi have been placed in supplementary classes, and they're at risk of being held back a year.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The classes will be held every day this week after school, starting today. I know that they've brought this on themselves by being inattentive to their studies.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If possible, I would like to make sure they enter second year alongside me, not only as my teammates, but also as my cherished friends.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And for that reason...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm here because I would greatly appreciate it if you could help me, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Why me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: For one thing, you're far more intelligent than I am. Also...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You have taught me many things in the past, and always in very easy-to-understand terms.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is that so?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Take, for example, the time I was an extra in that wedding ceremony.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, yes. We put on a wonderful show thanks to all of you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I had no acting experience, but I carried out that role thanks to your guidance, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I believe that the ability to give such guidance is an innate talent of yours.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And that's why, if it's not too much trouble, I'm asking for your help.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you, Aoyagi. Any praise of my work is always welcome.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I want to help him if I can. He's been my junior for almost a year now.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But I have a previous engagement... It might be difficult to help Aoyagi too.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But, no...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How about we take a group photo together?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
I'd like to have something to commemorate this day with.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Kamishiro?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, sorry about that. I was lost in thought.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As it turns out, Tsukasa has also been placed in supplementary classes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa has?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. And I've already promised to help him study, so I was thinking just now that it may be hard to also help you out this time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I...see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I have a suggestion...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What if we all gather in one location for a study session?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A study session...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It would be easy to meet up after school since we'd have access to empty classrooms.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course, I'd have to be the one helping Tsukasa as I'm in his year, but I'd still be able to help you three.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But, wouldn't that be asking a lot of you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Think nothing of it. Besides...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The school year is almost over, which means we'll soon be third-years, and you'll all be second-years.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think it might be a good occasion to make some memories.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Making memories...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, you're right. It's a wonderful idea.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, isn't it just? However, let's keep what I just said between you and me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The stakes are high for the others, with the threat of being held back looming over them. If they knew what I was thinking, it might not be well received.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Will you tell Tsukasa about the study group?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I'll speak to him later. We can hammer out the details when we meet after school.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Understood. Thank you for agreeing to this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Well... It really isn't like me to suggest something like making memories with a study session.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well then, I'd better go prepare. After all, our friends' academic futures hang in the balance.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I know I said all that, but...
With their grades at stake, I need to be responsible.
